scope: Frozen pre-expansion authoring helpers used only by differential controls; never a runtime fallback.

helpers.get:
def get(w: mutbuf, index: u64) -> u64:
    value = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        value = value | byte(w, index * 8 + i) << i * 8
        i = i + 1
    return value
helpers.read_word:
def read_word(s: readbuf, index: u64) -> u64:
    value = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        value = value | byte(s, index + i) << i * 8
        i = i + 1
    return value

helpers.hash_get:
def hash_get(w: mutbuf, index: u64) -> u64:
    value = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        value = value | byte(w, length(w) - 4096 + (index + i)) << i * 8
        i = i + 1
    return value
helpers.hash_put:
def hash_put(w: mutbuf, index: u64, value: u64) -> u64:
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        store(w, length(w) - 4096 + (index + i), value & 255)
        value = value >> 8
        i = i + 1
    return 0
